title.narrative: The CoCoNut Waste Project

description.narrative: To achieve a green-circular economy and create livelihood opportunities through value addition to coconut husks waste in the La Nkwantanang-Madina Municipality.Specific objectives:1. Establish coconut waste aggregation system in the target municipality;2.Institute a processing centre to convert coconut waste into selected useable products including cocopeat, paper and charcoal;3.Create linkages with market actors to procure value added products;
